Wallenberg syndrome: F4: no visual change or speech disturbance (although some patients may not exhibit these symptoms)
F6: medical history unremarkable (Wallenberg syndrome often associated with atherosclerosis, diabetes, or hypertension)
F15: cardiorespiratory examination normal (some cases may have associated cardiovascular risk factors)
F3: symptom onset with headache and vomiting, then right-sided numbness and weakness
F10: partial left ptosis, bilateral torsional nystagmus on vertical and horizontal gaze
F11: motor strength 0/5 in right upper limb, 3/5 proximally and 2/5 distally in right lower limb
F12: reflexes brisk bilaterally with right ankle clonus, right plantar response upgoing
F24: recent ischemic infarction in left paramedian medulla without hemorrhagic transformation
